name: atesa-dev
description: Orquestrador de desenvolvimento local do sistema ATESA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n REGIOES,USUARIOS,EMPRESAS,COMERCIAL,PARAMETRO,RA,GATEWAY,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta,yellow,red,orange,purple,green,cyan "node --env-file=backend/regioes-service/.env backend/regioes-service/src/server.js" "node --env-file=backend/usuarios-service/.env backend/usuarios-service/src/server.js" "node --env-file=backend/empresas-service/.env backend/empresas-service/src/server.js" "node --env-file=backend/comercial-service/.env backend/comercial-service/src/server.js" "node --env-file=backend/parametro-service/.env backend/parametro-service/src/server.js" "node --env-file=backend/ra-service/.env backend/ra-service/src/server.js" "node --env-file=backend/gateway/.env backend/gateway/src/server.js" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host=localhost --port=8100"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.migrate: npm --prefix backend/regioes-service run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend/usuarios-service run db:migrate && npm --prefix backend/empresas-service run db:migrate
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend/regioes-service install && npm --prefix backend/usuarios-service install && npm --prefix backend/empresas-service install && npm --prefix backend/comercial-service install && npm --prefix backend/parametro-service install && npm --prefix backend/ra-service install && npm --prefix backend/gateway install && npm --prefix frontend install
